title: ilm-stack redaction_v1
description: Regex patterns for client-side secret redaction. The emitter applies these BEFORE constructing events; the server re-scans and flags. A match means the content should be redacted (replaced with [REDACTED]) before sending.
note: allow_patterns override patterns — if an allow pattern matches the same text, the redaction is suppressed. This prevents false positives on schema/config documentation that names the fields.
